top_signals.title: ‘Not sustainable’ – French borrowing costs soar amid Budget and election uncertainty
top_signals.summary: France is facing a period of acute bond market stress that could last several years unless the presidential frontrunners for next year’s election commit to tackling its gaping deficit, analysts have warned.
